title: 第17章 探险二第18章 巨蟒雷特
slug: 重生之为蚁第816章未知岛屿
content_zh:
小心翼翼的走了一个多小时，前面又出现了一扇石门，和上个石门有些相似。一路上，尽管大家非常的小心，但仍旧造成了十几个受伤，一个死亡。
“我来！”
有了之前的经验，孙云自然更加得心应手，再次研究起来。这次，不到十分钟就被孙云打开了，显然石门不是阻挡的重点。
“伤兵留下，继续出发，先去一个人试试，小心点！”
孙云吩咐一声，再次整队前进。
已经没有小动物探险了，他们要更加小心了，只能慢慢探索。而最稳妥的办法，就是一个个探路，其它队友准备救援。
“好重，走不动！”
探路的雷霆战士，刚刚进入石门内，突然惊呼一声！
一时间，这位雷霆的战士，好像背着什么东西，被压弯了腰。突如其来的变故，让大家不敢冒进，都站在石门外观望！
“我来试试！”
孙云见没有出现危险，直接抬脚走了进去。
孙云虽然有心里准备，但还是被突如其来的重力，压弯了腰。自己的后背上，好像有千斤重石压再身上，根本就迈不开大步！
尤其是，越向前走，感觉身上全是重力越强。孙云只走了十几米，就浑身都是汗了。
“我们也跟上！”
疯战见孙云没有危险，带大家跟上来。
噗呲噗呲……
两阶以下的蚁兵，直接当场吐血。
其它队员，也好不到哪里去，一个个满脸通红。可见，它们被这种重力，压的非常辛苦。
“三阶以下的，全部退出！”
孙云看在眼里，直接命令道！

实力不够的蚁兵，如果要强行前进，无非是送死。孙云培养这些精英不容易，可不愿意损失任何一个。
“是！”
孙云的话，就是蚁兵们的最高指令，三阶以下的蚁兵，乖乖的退了出去。这样一来，百蚁队伍只剩下了不到一半，还在努力的坚持着。
可是，随着一点点的前进，实力差距就显现了出来，渐渐的拉开了距离。一些蚁兵，甚至没能安全退出去，被活生生的压死了！
“呼，终于到了！”
孙云实力最强，又最早出发的，首先到达了下一个石门。
紧随其后的，疯战、啊泰、瘦猴、小奇等蚁，也相继到达。最令人惊讶的，是小蛇腾黑，竟然也坚持了下来，只是受伤颇重。
当然，还有十几个蚁兵，也坚持了过来，大多都是雷霆战队成员。这次，非战斗死亡六七个，让孙云心疼不已，暗叹自己疏忽。
“大家原地修整，赶快恢复体力！”
孙云见都过来了，赶紧吩咐道。
好在，石门二十米内，没有了丝毫的压力，大家可以调养一下。尤其是腾黑，伤势太重了，孙云生怕它活不下来。
虽然，腾黑实力不错，已经有三阶中期的实力了。并且，也经过蚁兵的力量训练，但终究不是以力量为主的蚁类。能坚持下来，除了实力勉强可以，少不了超乎常人的毅力，
“老大，大家差不多了！”
经过一个多时辰的休息，啊泰向孙云汇报。
大家本来就不算外伤，只是消耗太大，有了异兽肉和魔兽晶核，恢复起来并不难。并且，通过这么一折腾，大家实力都有了点提升。
content_en:
After walking cautiously for more than an hour, another stone door appeared in front, which was somewhat similar to the previous one. Along the way, despite everyone's extreme caution, a dozen people were injured and one died.
"I'll do it!"
With his previous experience, Sun Yun naturally became more comfortable and started studying again. This time, Sun Yun opened it in less than ten minutes. It was obvious that the stone gate was not the focus of the obstruction.
"Stay the wounded soldier and continue to set off. Try it alone first, be careful!"
Sun Yun gave an order and moved forward as a team again.
There are no more small animals to explore, so they have to be more careful and can only explore slowly. The safest way is to explore the path one by one and other teammates prepare to rescue.
"It's so heavy, I can't walk!"
The Thunder Warrior who was exploring the way suddenly exclaimed as soon as he entered the stone gate!
For a moment, the Thunder warrior seemed to be carrying something and was bent over. The sudden change made everyone afraid to enter and stood outside the stone gate to watch!
"Let me try!"
Seeing that there was no danger, Sun Yun walked in directly.
Although Sun Yun was mentally prepared, he was still bent over by the sudden gravity. It felt like there was a thousand pounds of stone weighing on my back, and I couldn't even take a big step!
Especially, the further you move forward, the stronger the gravity becomes on your body. Sun Yun only walked a dozen meters and was covered in sweat.
"Let's follow too!"
Seeing that Sun Yun was not in danger, Kuang Zhan led everyone to follow him.
Puff puff puff...
The ant soldiers below level two immediately vomited blood on the spot.
The other team members were not much better, their faces were all red. It can be seen that they are pressed very hard by this gravity.
"All those below level three, quit!"
Sun Yun saw this and ordered directly!
If the ant soldiers who are not strong enough try to force their way forward, they will die. It is not easy for Sun Yun to cultivate these elites, and he is not willing to lose any of them.
"Yes!"
Sun Yun's words were the highest order for the ant soldiers. The ant soldiers below the third level obediently retreated. As a result, less than half of the Hundred Ant team was left, and they were still trying to persevere.
However, as they progressed a little bit, the gap in strength became apparent, and the distance gradually widened. Some ant soldiers couldn't even get out safely and were crushed to death!
"Phew, it's finally here!"
Sun Yun, who was the strongest and the first to set off, arrived at the next stone gate first.
Following closely behind, ants such as Kuang Zhan, Ah Tai, Shou Hou, Xiao Qi, etc. also arrived one after another. The most surprising thing was that the little snake Tenghei actually persisted, but was seriously injured.
Of course, there were a dozen ant soldiers who also persisted, most of them being members of the Thunder Team. This time, there were six or seven non-combat deaths, which made Sun Yun feel heartbroken and secretly lamented his negligence.
"Everyone repairs where you are and quickly regains your strength!"
Seeing everyone coming, Sun Yun quickly gave instructions.
Fortunately, there is no pressure at all within twenty meters of Shimen, so everyone can take care of themselves. Especially Teng Hei, the injury was so serious that Sun Yun was afraid that it wouldn't survive.
Although, Teng Hei is quite strong and already has the strength of mid-third level. Moreover, he has also received strength training from ant soldiers, but after all, he is not an ant that focuses on strength. Being able to persevere requires not only barely enough strength, but also extraordinary perseverance.
"Boss, everyone is almost done!"
After more than an hour of rest, Ah Tai reported to Sun Yun.
It was not considered a trauma for everyone, but it was just too much consumption. With the meat of alien beasts and the core of magical beasts, it is not difficult to recover. Moreover, through such a struggle, everyone's strength has improved a bit.
